releaseNotes: Starts the core web app before waiting for the question bank, keeps the Splash from being held by bank downloads, and supports browsers without Cache Storage.
Releases the startup Splash once the core app runtime is ready, without waiting for nonessential enhancement modules to finish loading.
Keeps existing iOS installs silent at launch; a legacy migration remains pending until a user-started update is verified, committed and cleaned up.
Checks the installed offline file inventory locally at launch and offers an explicit online-only Repair action in Settings, with a dismissible Home fallback.
Removes the unused startup retry marker while preserving automatic package discovery for first installs and the manual Settings update action.

Scopes iOS question and Settings observers to #phoneContent, coalesces decoration and organization through requestAnimationFrame, and prevents repeated DOM writes on unchanged question toolbars or Settings cards.
Fixes Settings navigation from the header and drawer by routing directly to the Settings screen.
Consolidates iPhone-supported study controls into the To Me-aligned Study experience card.
Stops the question toolbar MutationObserver re-render loop that could freeze question screens.
Disables scheduled startup update checks, automatic migration, and local repair prompts; existing installs update only from Settings.
Adds iPhone-compatible Follow device appearance and Keep screen awake controls, while preserving Question Bank tools and iOS update controls.
Adds iOS Question Bank tools for Share, Copy and Read aloud, groups bank controls in Settings, and scopes progress resets to the active bank, system and topic.
Aligns the iOS sidebar with To Me, exposes Exam Goal Planner, removes Smart Review badges, and shows installed/update version details in Settings.
Fixes mixed old/new files after updating from 1.4.10; cleans old caches
Keeps the iOS notification header route and manual App updates control in Settings while matching the current To Me drawer grouping.
Keeps all existing iOS sidebar page handlers, Smart Review navigation safeguards, and local student data.
Keeps the original iOS final two onboarding screens unchanged.
Fixes iOS first-time offline setup: retries the offline manifest request with a longer timeout and avoids blocking downloads on a forced Service Worker update.
Aligns the iOS app with the complete To Me interface, question-bank screens, visual assets, and shared study features.
Replaces the separate iOS offline installer and silent update layer with the To Me verified offline package and seven-day/manual update workflow.
Adds a working Check for updates control in Settings; only changed offline files are downloaded.
Preserves the iOS onboarding screens and existing student progress, notes, bookmarks, settings, and backup data.
